transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 974 Shawna Drive?
Yes, this is 974 Shawna Drive. I’m safe, alone, no water inside, and no help needed right now.
Thank you for confirming your address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Just me. No one else here.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Just me. No one else here.
Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave alone. No wheelchair or oxygen needed.
Understood, no one needs assistance to leave. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. I’m safe alone.
If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No, I don’t have a truck, boat, or free seats. I’m safe right now.
Let me read that back: people at the home not confirmed; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right. Just me here, no water inside yet.
Got it, you’re alone and no water inside yet. I wasn't able to confirm everything, so a responder may follow up with you. Goodbye.
